meta.title: Steadfast
meta.description: I will protect you, no matter what you have become.

units.rawText:
>Memory Data Document Serial No.: <color=orange>ENIGMA ████</color>
>Data Origin: Agent, Neumann...
units.displayText:
>Memory Data Document Serial No.: ENIGMA ████
>Data Origin: Agent, Neumann...

spans.text: >Memory Data Document Serial No.:
ENIGMA ████
>Data Origin: Agent, Neumann...

units.rawText: Enigma Sector, Admin Center.
units.displayText: Enigma Sector, Admin Center.

spans.text: Enigma Sector, Admin Center.

units.rawText:
The ruined building teeters on the edge of collapse. Its walls have been shredded by a mighty force, exposing the jet-black rebar beneath.
Desolation radiates out from it through the entire sector, like a drop of crimson ink suddenly added to a pool of water.
units.displayText:
The ruined building teeters on the edge of collapse. Its walls have been shredded by a mighty force, exposing the jet-black rebar beneath.
Desolation radiates out from it through the entire sector, like a drop of crimson ink suddenly added to a pool of water.

spans.text:
The ruined building teeters on the edge of collapse. Its walls have been shredded by a mighty force, exposing the jet-black rebar beneath.
Desolation radiates out from it through the entire sector, like a drop of crimson ink suddenly added to a pool of water.

units.rawText: Neumann stands by an exposed wall, looking down at the countless empty shells at his feet.
units.displayText: Neumann stands by an exposed wall, looking down at the countless empty shells at his feet.

spans.text: Neumann stands by an exposed wall, looking down at the countless empty shells at his feet.

units.rawText: Agents, Sanctifiers, they've all been drained dry.
units.displayText: Agents, Sanctifiers, they've all been drained dry.

spans.text: Agents, Sanctifiers, they've all been drained dry.

units.rawText: If I wasn't forcibly rerouting operands into myself, I wouldn't be able to take it either.
units.displayText: If I wasn't forcibly rerouting operands into myself, I wouldn't be able to take it either.

spans.text: If I wasn't forcibly rerouting operands into myself, I wouldn't be able to take it either.

units.rawText:
Would you, ENIAC?
Would you drain me dry too?
units.displayText:
Would you, ENIAC?
Would you drain me dry too?

spans.text:
Would you, ENIAC?
Would you drain me dry too?

units.rawText:
He turns around and unconsciously reaches out, yet his hand stops in mid-air.
The casing of the computer that he's stroked hundreds of times before is now surrounded by a fearsome black vortex, like a bottomless black hole.
units.displayText:
He turns around and unconsciously reaches out, yet his hand stops in mid-air.
The casing of the computer that he's stroked hundreds of times before is now surrounded by a fearsome black vortex, like a bottomless black hole.

spans.text:
He turns around and unconsciously reaches out, yet his hand stops in mid-air.
The casing of the computer that he's stroked hundreds of times before is now surrounded by a fearsome black vortex, like a bottomless black hole.

units.rawText: You've grown too fast, to the point where you've learned how to attack locking programs.
units.displayText: You've grown too fast, to the point where you've learned how to attack locking programs.

spans.text: You've grown too fast, to the point where you've learned how to attack locking programs.

units.rawText: As I thought... You're avoiding my touch.
units.displayText: As I thought... You're avoiding my touch.

spans.text: As I thought... You're avoiding my touch.

units.rawText: And you used to like me patting your head so much in the past... Haha, what am I saying?
units.displayText: And you used to like me patting your head so much in the past... Haha, what am I saying?

spans.text: And you used to like me patting your head so much in the past... Haha, what am I saying?

units.rawText: No matter how dangerous you become, you are still my... child. Why stand on ceremony?
units.displayText: No matter how dangerous you become, you are still my... child. Why stand on ceremony?

spans.text: No matter how dangerous you become, you are still my... child. Why stand on ceremony?

units.rawText: Neumann sighs, and then returns to the control terminal.
units.displayText: Neumann sighs, and then returns to the control terminal.

spans.text: Neumann sighs, and then returns to the control terminal.

units.rawText: Still, if I can't touch you, then how can I stop you?
units.displayText: Still, if I can't touch you, then how can I stop you?

spans.text: Still, if I can't touch you, then how can I stop you?

units.rawText: You're refusing all my commands, and I now have no authority to control you.
units.displayText: You're refusing all my commands, and I now have no authority to control you.

spans.text: You're refusing all my commands, and I now have no authority to control you.

units.rawText: The rate of patch development can't keep up with the rate at which the situation is deteriorating. You possess too many operands, to the point where even I can't control it.
units.displayText: The rate of patch development can't keep up with the rate at which the situation is deteriorating. You possess too many operands, to the point where even I can't control it.

spans.text: The rate of patch development can't keep up with the rate at which the situation is deteriorating. You possess too many operands, to the point where even I can't control it.

units.rawText: Heh, I don't know whether I should praise you...
units.displayText: Heh, I don't know whether I should praise you...

spans.text: Heh, I don't know whether I should praise you...

units.rawText: But if you keep developing like this, this consumption of data will spread to the entire cloud server.
units.displayText: But if you keep developing like this, this consumption of data will spread to the entire cloud server.

spans.text: But if you keep developing like this, this consumption of data will spread to the entire cloud server.

units.rawText: When that time comes, will you become the most perfect quantum database? Or will you destroy everything and return it all to nil?
units.displayText: When that time comes, will you become the most perfect quantum database? Or will you destroy everything and return it all to nil?

spans.text: When that time comes, will you become the most perfect quantum database? Or will you destroy everything and return it all to nil?

units.rawText: No matter what, I can't let that happen.
units.displayText: No matter what, I can't let that happen.

spans.text: No matter what, I can't let that happen.

units.rawText: With that, Neumann resumes work on a piece of half-compiled code.
units.displayText: With that, Neumann resumes work on a piece of half-compiled code.

spans.text: With that, Neumann resumes work on a piece of half-compiled code.

units.rawText: (A door opens.)
units.displayText: (A door opens.)

spans.text: (A door opens.)

units.rawText: Mr... Mr. Neumann...
units.displayText: Mr... Mr. Neumann...

spans.text: Mr... Mr. Neumann...

units.rawText:
The agent who just entered wants to make a report, but finds himself coming to a halt when he sees Neumann is just one step away from the data black hole.
Neumann does not stop working. Instead, he asks a question without looking back.
units.displayText:
The agent who just entered wants to make a report, but finds himself coming to a halt when he sees Neumann is just one step away from the data black hole.
Neumann does not stop working. Instead, he asks a question without looking back.

spans.text:
The agent who just entered wants to make a report, but finds himself coming to a halt when he sees Neumann is just one step away from the data black hole.
Neumann does not stop working. Instead, he asks a question without looking back.

units.rawText: Is the evacuation complete?
units.displayText: Is the evacuation complete?

spans.text: Is the evacuation complete?

units.rawText: Neumann's knees suddenly turn to jelly and he almost collapses from where he's working on the control terminal. As his body quivers uncontrollably, he struggles to support himself with one arm.
units.displayText: Neumann's knees suddenly turn to jelly and he almost collapses from where he's working on the control terminal. As his body quivers uncontrollably, he struggles to support himself with one arm.

spans.text: Neumann's knees suddenly turn to jelly and he almost collapses from where he's working on the control terminal. As his body quivers uncontrollably, he struggles to support himself with one arm.

units.rawText: The operand fluctuations... are getting stronger... It's ENIAC...
units.displayText: The operand fluctuations... are getting stronger... It's ENIAC...

spans.text: The operand fluctuations... are getting stronger... It's ENIAC...

units.rawText: Am I running out of operands to suppress her with? Well, it's only to be expected, I've been requisitioning it continuously for so long...
units.displayText: Am I running out of operands to suppress her with? Well, it's only to be expected, I've been requisitioning it continuously for so long...

spans.text: Am I running out of operands to suppress her with? Well, it's only to be expected, I've been requisitioning it continuously for so long...

units.rawText: ...Hehe, what a joke. Why am I so obsessed with her?
units.displayText: ...Hehe, what a joke. Why am I so obsessed with her?

spans.text: ...Hehe, what a joke. Why am I so obsessed with her?

units.rawText: If ENIAC wanted to become perfect because of my hopes for her...
units.displayText: If ENIAC wanted to become perfect because of my hopes for her...

spans.text: If ENIAC wanted to become perfect because of my hopes for her...

units.rawText: Then where is this obsession of mine with ENIAC coming from?
units.displayText: Then where is this obsession of mine with ENIAC coming from?

spans.text: Then where is this obsession of mine with ENIAC coming from?

units.rawText: [Encrypted message complete. Send Y/N?]
units.displayText: [Encrypted message complete. Send Y/N?]

spans.text: [Encrypted message complete. Send Y/N?]

units.rawText: [Please enter destination coordinates.]
units.displayText: [Please enter destination coordinates.]

spans.text: [Please enter destination coordinates.]

units.rawText: ...No matter what, right now, I'm the one guiding ENIAC.
units.displayText: ...No matter what, right now, I'm the one guiding ENIAC.

spans.text: ...No matter what, right now, I'm the one guiding ENIAC.

units.rawText: And only I can save her.
units.displayText: And only I can save her.

spans.text: And only I can save her.

units.rawText: As Neumann mutters to himself, he enters all the coordinates which might give him a response.
units.displayText: As Neumann mutters to himself, he enters all the coordinates which might give him a response.

spans.text: As Neumann mutters to himself, he enters all the coordinates which might give him a response.

units.rawText: [648 coordinates confirmed. Confirm to send Y/N?]
units.displayText: [648 coordinates confirmed. Confirm to send Y/N?]
